scope: Independent saved JSON/CSV arithmetic and provenance; no encoder/decoder execution, no checkpoint module loading, no head fitting, no host project execution.
arithmetic_execution: Python 3 standard library only inside existing cuwacunu container; PowerShell only local file hashes and Git ignore diagnostics.

checkpoint_git_ignore.method: Direct argv paths; no native stdin line conversion

limitations: Fixed prior/scaler/bank preservation and actual typed next-step equality are independently bound runtime proof/guard claims; this arithmetic audit does not deserialize model tensors.
Row means are independently recalculated from full saved per-row values; 2e-15 absolute tolerance permits summation order differences.
MT19937_64 and SplitMix64 are independently implemented in the auditor; 16,384 row choices and 2,048 stream pairs match exactly.
